title: The Miracle of Flatness in Algebraic Geometry
summary: This thesis studies various aspects of flatness in algebraic geometry. We first study flatness in the context of semi-rings. We prove some discreteness results for a derived groupification functor with respect to the homotopy theoretic model structure on simplicial semirings, compare the Zariski and fppf topology, and study fppf algebras over the positive reals.
